slug: 2021-08-04 Health information systems in developing countries case of African countries

facts.fact: A literature review in BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making found that 11 of the 12 African countries studied (92%), Botswana among them and Malawi the only exception, had no national health information strategy for their DHIS-based data warehouse, only strategies run under donor-funded projects; the review was carried out in February to July 2019 and gives no date for the finding, so the published date is used.

systems.tiers: a single data warehouse into which all the subsystems' paper forms were to be integrated without prior standardisation, producing overlap and duplication; tiers not stated

note: Botswana is treated in two sentences, drawn from a 2011 comparison of four countries; the review gives no tier, level of data entry or clinic count for it.
